from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    twos = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = ones[0], twos[0]
    dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
    sr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
    sc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
    diagonal = max(0, min(abs(dr), abs(dc)) - 1)
    r, c = r1, c1
    for _ in range(diagonal):
        r += sr
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    if abs(dr) > diagonal:
        for _ in range(abs(dr) - diagonal - 1):
            r += sr
            out[r][c] = 3
    elif abs(dc) > diagonal:
        for _ in range(abs(dc) - diagonal - 1):
            c += sc
            out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-d1090f49.py'
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), globals())

def makegrid(h,w,pts):
    a=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c,v in pts:a[r][c]=v
    return a

print('demo1',transform(demo1_in)==demo1_expected,'demo2',transform(demo2_in)==demo2_expected)
test=makegrid(16,16,[(1,4,1),(13,12,2)])
answer=transform(test)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in answer))
